name: Luxury condos over $1 million Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condos over $1 million in Miami can range from premium urban residences to waterfront and oceanfront homes with concierge services and resort-style amenities. Kelby Contreras helps buyers compare buildings, unit quality, views, fees, rental policies, and market value.
